title: Cellar and Harvest
author: Yara Whitlock
blurb: Odile Galloway, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
